construction: Two partitions of128 atoms into16 groups of8. Per-seed initialization uses independent torch randperm calls seeded38000+seed, identical for both source objectives. Random condition uses these unchanged. Coactivation condition uses exactly20000 within-partition atom-swap proposals from NumPy RNG39000+seed, accepting only strict objective increase>1e-12. No restart, evaluation selection, decoder/encoder fitting or coefficient tuning.
affinity: Training mean of outer products of squared PRE-GATE coordinates, normalized to cosine similarity per atom. Zero-energy atoms have zero off-diagonal affinity. Natural documents0..31 contribute total weight.5 equally by document then token; scheduled task endpoints for eachseed contribute total.5 equally over120endpoints then token, preserving repeated endpoint multiplicity.
group_objective: Sum upper-triangular affinity for atom pairs sharing at least one group; pairs shared in both partitions count once. This rewards captured coactivation edges without rewarding duplicate pair coverage.
constraints: Exactly8 atoms per group, exactly2 memberships per atom. No group resizing, dropped atoms or extra encoder/gate parameters. Duplicate/overlapping groups measured rather than hidden; no semantic recovery claim.
selection: All4 scalar source states (both seeds and both training objectives) retained. Each source compared as unchanged scalarTop32, balanced-random overlapping groups, and training-coactivation groups. Dictionary/encoder/bias/normalization tensors bitwise frozen.
evaluation: First report training group objective and local decoding/error/support statistics on scheduled training data and all4096 natural evaluation positions, explicitly separating training and development evaluation. Then all candidates on unchanged native benchmark and output inventory, plus selective shared-atom versus group-gate removal. No evaluation used to construct memberships.
budget_caveat: Same296192 trainable-source parameters now frozen,128atoms and maximum32active; realized unions may differ systematically. Report active counts, coverage, duplicate groups and pair overlaps. Better objective is not evidence of better native computation or meaningful manifolds.
data_status: Familiar development data, not a pristine holdout.
